caption:
What truly gives you life? Allah answers

Allah calls the believers to respond to Him and His Messenger when He calls them to what gives them life. He reminds us that He comes between a person and his heart, and to Him we will all be gathered.

Surah Al-Anfaal 8:24

Name one call from Allah you will answer today.

#respondtoallah #surahanfal #livingheart #quranreflection

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
